verdict.rationale: The evidence describes n8n as a visual/code workflow builder and shows it can power AI agents and NL-to-API workflows *inside* workflows (e.g. n8n-docs-26), but there is no evidence that n8n itself can be operated/built/configured via natural-language commands (e.g., an AI assistant that creates or edits workflows from a prompt). Missing for 10: any documentation of a natural-language interface for controlling the n8n platform itself, hands-on evidence of prompt-driven workflow creation, or an AI copilot/chat feature for building n8n workflows.
